phrase.en: It's too expensive — we can't afford it.
phrase.ru: Это слишком дорого — мы не можем себе это позволить.
phrase.es: Es demasiado caro: no nos lo podemos permitir.

text.ru: too + прилагательное — «слишком»: too expensive. Сравнение коротких — -er: cheaper; длинных — more: more expensive. «Позволить себе» — can afford, обычно с can / can't.
text.en: too + adjective means “more than you want”: too expensive. Short adjectives add -er (cheaper), long ones take more (more expensive). afford is usually used with can / can’t.
text.es: too + adjetivo = demasiado: too expensive. Comparativo: cheaper, more expensive. afford suele ir con can / can’t.

examples.en: The bus is cheaper than a taxi.

exercises.en: We can't ___ a hotel in the centre.
exercises.ru: Мы не можем позволить себе отель в центре.

exercises.en: The train is ___ than the plane.
The price is too high for us.
